claims.evidence: Witness report shows a boxed PS5 game case titled “GOD OF WAR RAGNAROK” with PS branding and PEGI 18.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired
claims.evidence: Witness only saw the boxed game case; no disc/internals or seal status shown.
Overheating would relate to a console, but the witness only reported a PS5 game case.
Ports working would relate to a console; witness only reported a game case.

claims.claim: Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt
claims.evidence: Witness report does not mention pads/inserts or any receipt being shown.

risks.risk: Disc may be missing or damaged (scratches/marks) even if the case is present.
risks.proof: A clear photo/video of the disc itself (both sides) and a close-up of any label/condition, plus a shot showing the disc is inside the case.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used/possibly incomplete game case without confirmed disc condition (worst case: disc missing or untested).

risks.risk: Case may be incomplete (missing inserts/manuals/back cover) or the box may be damaged.
risks.proof: Photos of the back cover, spine, and all included inserts/manuals (if any) laid out.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete packaging (worst case: missing inserts/manuals).

risks.risk: Region/edition and language may not match what the buyer expects (import/locked edition).
risks.proof: A photo of the region/edition details and any language/compatibility text on the back/inside artwork.
risks.if_unproven: Price as standard/unknown edition with no guarantee of language/region suitability.

risks.risk: “Never opened” may be false; the copy could be previously opened/used.
risks.proof: A photo showing whether the seal/sticker is intact (if applicable) and/or a photo of the inside packaging/disc holder condition.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used (not sealed) since opening status is not confirmed.

risks.risk: Receipt/UK proof may not actually be included (or may not correspond to the item).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the receipt showing the item name and date (with sensitive details optionally blurred).

proof_requests: Show whether the disc is included: photo/video of the disc (both sides) and confirm it’s inside the case.
Show the full case condition: front, back, spine, and any inserts/manuals (if any).
Show region/edition/language details from the back/inside artwork.
If claiming “never opened,” show the seal/sticker status (close-up).
Show the UK receipt (photo) with the game name visible (blur personal details).
response.reason: The witness confirms the boxed PS5 game case title, but key value drivers (disc inclusion/condition, completeness, edition/region, and receipt/inserts) are not shown. Without those shots, a worst-case price would be too uncertain to set confidently.
